description: submission.rs handle_submission_set(): for non-creation-reference submission IDs (those not starting with '#'), the submission → email_id mapping is pre-populated in submission_email_id_map BEFORE the update and destroy loops run (lines 358-397). If the update or destroy of the referenced EmailSubmission fails and produces a notUpdated/notDestroyed entry, the ID is still in submission_email_id_map. RFC 8621 §7.5 says onSuccessUpdateEmail/onSuccessDestroyEmail effects apply only when the referenced create/update/destroy succeeds. Trigger: {"update": {"sub1": {"undoStatus": "final"}}, "onSuccessUpdateEmail": {"sub1": {"keywords/": true}}} where sub1 update fails (e.g. already final → cannotUnsend). Bad behavior: email referenced by sub1 gets keywords/ set even though the submission update failed.
title: onSuccessUpdateEmail/DestroyEmail applied even when EmailSubmission update/destroy fails
